narrative.details:
Erm... 'Ello, <mister/miss>. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
narrative.objectives: Gather 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?
narrative.requestItemsText: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
